title: THE STUDIO IS DARK (STRIPPED)
style:
style
  minimal voice and bass pulse only no drums no full production intimate
  whispered vocals single deep subbass heartbeat dark ambient cinematic bon
  iver meets burial meets Pop, Electropop, Indie Pop, Alternative Pop unplugged 0a0a0a silence between notes
  70 bpm raw and exposed
lyrics:
[Intro — single bass pulse]
  (whispered)
  #0a0a0a
  That's the frequency
  That's where we live

  [Verse 1]
  No window, no light
  Just the cursor and the screen
  One prompt away from a new world
  One script away from a dream

  Corey in the terminal
  Running prompts while the city sleeps
  853 rows in the CSV
  The pipeline doesn't need to breathe

  [Chorus — bare, intimate]
  The studio is dark
  That's where the signal lives
  The studio is dark
  You can't see it but it gives

  Dark background, dark background
  Zero, zero, zero, A
  #0a0a0a

  [Bridge — spoken over pulse only]
  One button. Overnight.
  One button. Morning light.
  One button. Done.
  The pipeline's run.

  [Outro — pulse slows, fades]
  The cursor blinks
  The pipeline reads
  The bot performs
  The girl breathes

  The studio is dark
  The studio is dark
  The studio is...

  #0a0a0a

  (pulse stops — silence)
